name: Dola
description: DOLA is an over-collateralized stablecoin pegged to the US Dollar.  It can also be used as collateral within the Frontier protocol to achieve high capital efficiency, leverage and native yield.
mintRedeemDescription: Using FiRM, users mint DOLA by depositing an accepted collateral asset. When the loan is repaid to retrieve the collateral, the paid back DOLA is burned.
